# Fernando Nahuel Tuquina

> Senior Software Engineer (backend) based in Tucumán, Argentina. Currently at ITTI working for ueno bank (Lending tribe, Collections team). Former Backend Tech Lead at Coto Digital. Spanish (native), English (intermediate).

The interactive CV is available in Spanish (`/?lang=es`) and English (`/?lang=en`). The "Download" menu generates text-based PDFs of the resume, the achievements and the cover letter.

## Experience

- Senior Software Engineer — ITTI, client ueno bank (Aug 2025 – present). Backend services for the loan collections domain. Hybrid methodology combining traditional and agentic development with Spec-Driven Development (SDD), using Cursor and GitHub Copilot.
- Backend Tech Lead — Coto Digital (May 2024 – Jul 2025). Led the backend team; Kafka messaging architecture, centralized Redis caching, .NET 8 microservice template, Serilog request tracing.
- .NET Programmer Analyst — Coto (Jul 2022 – May 2024). .NET microservices in Docker with Oracle and SQL Server; store operations platform for 2,000+ concurrent users in 40+ stores; automatic billing (180,000+ invoices).
- Teaching Assistant — FACET, Universidad Nacional de Tucumán (2018 – 2019, 2021 – 2023).

## Skills
